SELECT p.id,
    p.created_at,
    p.last_seen,
    p.phone_verified,
    p.is_vip,
    p.vip_tier,
    p.vip_expires_at,
    p.referred_by,
    p.username,
    u.email_confirmed_at
   FROM (profiles p
     JOIN auth.users u ON ((u.id = p.id)))
  WHERE ((NOT COALESCE(p.is_horse, false)) AND (NOT COALESCE(u.is_anonymous, false)) AND ((p.id)::text !~~ '00000000-0000-0000-0000-%'::text) AND (POSITION(('@'::text) IN (COALESCE(u.email, ''::character varying))) > 0) AND (lower((u.email)::text) !~ '(\.invalid|\.local|\.test|@horses\.smarter\.poker|@hydra\.bot|@example\.(com|org|net))$'::text) AND (lower((u.email)::text) !~ '@([a-z0-9-]+\.)*(smarter\.poker|pepnationlab\.com|bekavactrading\.com)$'::text) AND (lower(COALESCE(p.email, ''::text)) !~ '(\.invalid|\.local|\.test|@hydra\.bot|@example\.(com|org|net))$'::text) AND (COALESCE(p.username, ''::text) !~* '^(deleted-|crest_cert_|postdeploy|reels_qa|trivia_canary|codex-)'::text) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM ca_cert_accounts c
          WHERE ((c.user_id = p.id) AND c.active)))));

SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'breaks', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('total', count(*), 'passed', count(*) FILTER (WHERE verdict = 'pass'))
                 FROM public.ca_break_scorecards WHERE recorded_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND recorded_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz),
    'deploys', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('attempted', count(*), 'shipped', count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.shipped OR a.superseded),
                                     'superseded', count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.superseded))
                  /* A RELEASE THAT STOOD DOWN FOR A NEWER ONE THAT SHIPPED DID
                     SHIP (2026-10-16). The receiver stands an older revision
                     down when protected main has moved on; the newer revision
                     contains it. Counted as shipped only when the revision it
                     names really shipped within twelve hours either side. */
                  FROM (SELECT x.shipped,
                               (NOT x.shipped AND EXISTS (
                                  SELECT 1 FROM public.ca_engine_deploy_attempts y
                                   WHERE y.shipped
                                     AND y.target_sha = substring(x.reason from 'protected main had moved to ([0-9a-f]{40})')
                                     AND y.at BETWEEN x.at - interval '12 hours' AND x.at + interval '12 hours')) AS superseded
                          FROM public.ca_engine_deploy_attempts x WHERE x.at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND x.at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz) a),
    'alerts_new', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('critical', count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical'), 'warning', count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'warning'))
                     FROM public.operational_alert_events WHERE received_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND received_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz
                      AND investigation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'informational' AND severity IN ('critical','warning')),
    'alerts_top', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT alertname, severity, count(*) n FROM public.operational_alert_events
         WHERE received_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND received_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND investigation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'informational' AND severity IN ('critical','warning')
         GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 8) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'alert_names', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(alertname, n) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(alertname,'unknown') alertname, count(*) n FROM public.operational_alert_events
         WHERE received_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND received_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND investigation_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'informational' AND severity = 'critical'
         GROUP BY 1) x), '{}'::jsonb),
    'alerts_fixed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.operational_alert_events WHERE investigation_touched_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND investigation_touched_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz
                       AND investigation_status = 'verified_fixed'),
    'financial_alerts_new', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('critical', count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical'), 'warning', count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'warning'))
                               FROM public.financial_alerts WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz),
    'financial_alerts_open', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.financial_alerts WHERE NOT resolved AND severity IN ('critical','warning')),
    'drift_open', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_drift_incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL),
    'drift_past_deadline', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_drift_incidents WHERE resolved_at IS NULL AND deadline_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz),
    'ledger_findings', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_ledger_invariant_findings WHERE found_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND found_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz),
    'diamond_incidents_new', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_diamond_incidents WHERE occurred_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND occurred_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND severity <> 'info'),
    'client_errors', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(occurrences),0) FROM public.client_error_events WHERE received_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND received_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz),
    'client_errors_top', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(x) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(code,''), error_name, 'unknown') k, sum(occurrences) n
         FROM public.client_error_events WHERE received_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND received_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'db_timeouts', (SELECT COALESCE(sum(occurrences),0) FROM public.client_error_events WHERE received_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND received_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND code = '57014'),
    -- An app crash is an error boundary catching a render failure. The auth
    -- flow''2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz own failure reports (boundary 'auth': a wrong password, an
    -- unconfirmed email) and delivery probes share client_crash_log but are
    -- not crashes (2026-10-16: both "app crashes" on Oct 15 were login form
    -- refusals, DailyDigest.client_crash).
    'crashes', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.client_crash_log WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz
                  AND boundary IS DISTINCT FROM 'auth' AND error_name IS DISTINCT FROM 'Probe'),
    'signup_errors', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.signup_errors WHERE occurred_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND occurred_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz),
    'probe_failures', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(probe_name, n) FROM (SELECT COALESCE(probe_name,'unknown') probe_name, count(*) n FROM public.probe_heartbeats
         WHERE occurred_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND occurred_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND status = 'failed' GROUP BY 1) x), '{}'::jsonb),
    -- signals between two horses are the house playing itself; only pairs with a real player count
    'collusion_signals', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_collusion_signals c WHERE c.detected_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND c.detected_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND NOT COALESCE(c.both_cert,false)
                           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.sp_real_humans hu WHERE hu.id IN (c.user_a, c.user_b))),
    'collusion_signals_horse_only', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.ca_collusion_signals c WHERE c.detected_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND c.detected_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND NOT COALESCE(c.both_cert,false)
                           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.sp_real_humans hu WHERE hu.id IN (c.user_a, c.user_b))),
    'beta_accounts_flagged', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT p.username) FROM public.ca_collusion_signals c
         JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id IN (c.user_a, c.user_b)
        WHERE c.detected_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND c.detected_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND p.username ~* '^(kingfish|danimal)'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'push', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('sent', COALESCE(sum(sent),0), 'failed', COALESCE(sum(failed),0))
               FROM public.push_dispatch_runs WHERE started_at >= '2026-10-20 05:00Z'::timestamptz AND started_at < '2026-10-21 05:00Z'::timestamptz)
  )
